scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter control-plane dev" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev" "cd tunnel-server && go run ./cmd/tunneld"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter control-plane build & pnpm --filter dashboard build & (cd tunnel-server && go build -o bin/tunneld ./cmd/tunneld) & wait
scripts.go:check: cd tunnel-server && go vet ./... && go test -race ./...
scripts.format: oxfmt --write control-plane dashboard && pnpm run go:format
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check control-plane dashboard && pnpm run go:format:check
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run go:check
